table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	CustomerCategory=Name1, 
	CustomerAlias=Name2, 
	Customer=Name3, 
	SaleType=Name4,
	Date=Date1, 
	NetSale=Value1,	
	Discount=Value2
FROM 
	ReportData
ORDER BY 
	Name1, Name2, Name3, Date1
table.sort: customercategory A, customeralias A, customer A, discount A

objects.name: compute_17
objects.expression: "Report Date:" + STRING(day( today() )) + '/' + STRING(month( today() )) + '/' + STRING(year( today() )) + SPACE(10) + SPACE(5) + "From :" +  STRING(day(ad_startdate )) + '/' + STRING(month(ad_startdate )) + '/' + STRING(year(ad_startdate )) + SPACE(10) + "To :" +  STRING(day(ad_enddate)) + '/' + STRING(month(ad_enddate)) + '/' + STRING(year(ad_enddate))

objects.name: netsale_t
objects.text: trim(case(month(date(left("@date", 10))) when 1 then 'JAN.' when 2 then 'FEB.' when 3 then 'MAR.' when 4 then 'APR.' when 5 then 'MAY' when 6 then 'JUNE' when 7 then 'JULY' when 8 then 'AUG.' when 9 then 'SEPT.' when 10 then 'OCT.' when 11 then 'NOV.' else 'DEC.') + '~r~n' + Right(left("@date", 10), 4))

objects.name: compute_19
objects.expression: crosstabsum( 1 ) / if( daysafter( ad_startdate, ad_enddate ) = 0 , 1, daysafter( ad_startdate, ad_enddate ))

props.sourcenames: customercategory, customeralias, customer, saletype, date, netsale, discount
